name: Ichi
source:
A girl from a mountain village who is derisively referred to as "Wild Dog" and is compelled to. In the past, she suffered an injury that left her with one eye blind. She lived by herself in a remote hut and rarely visited the village.

However, due to pressing circumstances, Ichi laid hands on [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url]'s belongings, was easily captured and mercilessly raped. For better or worse, her nose is more acute than an ordinary person's, so she got into a predicament: [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] dragged her with him as a substitute for a hound and a handy outlet for his sexual and violent urges.

The rope around her neck was not untied until the end of the story.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
